title: Plan group credit
summary: Each post-deploy plan shared by two or more members at item QA entry runs once per release as a driver-owned group of memberless rows. A group closes when the existing settlement and acceptance rules accept it and records covered_item_ids once: the members attaching the plan at that moment. An item is done only when each shared post-deploy plan has a closed group covering it, or its single-member plan has accepted member-bound evidence in a target-qualified completion run, including a supplemental staging run, or a run that run superseded. A closed group never changes or moves; a later item or attachment gets a new group with its own group_id. A verification pass never counts. --plan P at item-qa names P's open group and refuses plan_group_not_open, listing closed groups, when none is open; the holder executes a single-member plan through its member QA command. Ownership freezes at item QA entry: a plan attached by one member runs as member QA and wakes its holder; two or more attachers make a driver-owned shared group. Later attachments never change ownership. Pending, failed and passed shared plans send no holder notice; holders wake only for their own QA and close-out. A run-wide call naming a single-member plan refuses plan_member_owned with the owning item and exact member QA command. A manual-wake notice sent to its holder tells that session to run the QA itself rather than hand it to a parent or driver; steering notices retain their staffing guidance.
